correctness.rationale: An arc containing three selected edges is shortest iff two consecutive cyclic index gaps sum <=floor(n/2)-1, so legal sets require each adjacent pair sum >=floor(n/2). Summing inequalities excludes five edges n>=6; composition counting yields exact even and odd cubic/quartic coefficients, and a triple is extendable to a four-set iff one gap >=floor(n/2). Independent symbolic substitution checks every coefficient against the October26 earlier formulas identically for both parities; the proof itself valid. The supplied standard-library verify.py enumerates original geodesic paths instead of only gap formulas. n<=5 has no geodesic of 3 edges.
